title: Kusanagi Nene — The Confidence You Gave Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Singing practice♪ Singing practice♪ So much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Do you want to practice too, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, but before we do that, there's something I want to talk to you about...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Talk with me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Today, at school...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Look, Kusanagi's here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Good morning, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?! G-Good morning...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Take a look at this! Here, this part!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, it's a video of our Project Wonder show. I heard that it blew up online but...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
This is you, right, Kusanagi?
I didn't know that you're a PXL cast member!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I am...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: That explains why you're so good at singing! Now I get why you're always amazing during music class too!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah. That other girl from Miya Girls and even those second years, Tenma and Kamishiro, were in it too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... It's because we all perform together at this place called the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: That's so cool! Come to think of it, you said that you knew Kamishiro when we talked during the School Festival!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He's my neighbor so...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I haven't been to PXL in forever. I used to go so much when I was a kid...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you don't anymore...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Well, the ride that I really liked got torn down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: It was the one where Phenny and Poochie would chase each other around too...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, now I remember. You said that you were really sad to see it get replaced by one of those shooting rides.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah. Just the other day, I even saw the fish coaster all tarped over in a photo I saw online...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I'm guessing the park doesn't have much of a choice. No one's gonna come if it's full of old and rickety rides...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Oh no, I'm sorry.
We're standing right next to someone who works there.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
No, you're right!
I'm sorry for saying something so awful...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's okay... My friends were really worried about how Phoenix Wonderland was changing too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's okay! Phoenix Wonderland won't stop being the place that makes everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We did that show you saw just for that...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it, something about it felt pretty different...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Like its scale and stuff... It felt like it brought all of PXL together, you know?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It was just all of the other troupes performing together either. We even had the staff for all the rides and attractions join in too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Each part of the story was meant to tie into different parts of the park...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: That's right! A ton of people were saying on social media that the story and all the effects were really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I wanted to get a better idea of the story too. I must've spent hours trying to find a video that got your whole show from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, how was it?
Did you like it?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: That's the thing... The other guests sort of made it hard to hear what was going on. Plus, the person taking the video seemed pretty far away from it all...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I only got the gist of the story, and that the Miya Girls student and Tenma were the protagonists.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: That's why I want to go to PXL the next time I can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, these videos are great and all, but it would be better to see it ourselves, huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Maybe I'll go too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah. Everyone in the videos I saw looked like they were having so much fun. I wished that I could've been there too...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Also... After seeing your show, Kusanagi, I kind of want to see you and your friends perform at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
Then why don't we all go next weekend or something?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
I'll be waiting for you at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you'll keep the Phoenix Wonderland you know and love in your hearts, even if it does change a little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm just a single cast member...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the park where I'm able to put shows on with my friends means everything to me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is what happened...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There might be other people who saw their favorite rides get torn down just like my classmate...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But Project Wonder became a success and it sounds like they actually want to visit the park again...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like I've been tearing up a lot lately...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks, Nene!
I'm really, really happy to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eep! Wait, Emu!
Stop, this is really embarrassing...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No! Your cheeks are so soft and full of love♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No..! Hahaha! That tickles...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Since your friends are gonna come and visit, we have to work extra super hard for them♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't you always doing that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But maybe I should try a little harder too...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want them to know just how much fun Phoenix Wonderland is going to be from now on.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, shall we start singing practice then?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!
